title: FTTH Broadband Down — Red Light on ONT
content:
# Call Transcript: FTTH Broadband Down — Red Light on ONT

**Document ID:** TRX_006
**Category:** C25 — Broadband & FTTH Services
**Department:** Network
**Customer Scope:** all
**Last Updated:** 2026-07-08
**Version:** 1.0
**Source Authority:** Internal Knowledge Base
**Channel:** Voice (Call Centre)

---
## Conversation

Agent: NovaTel broadband support, this is Sanjay.
Customer: My internet is down, the light on the box is red.
Agent: Understood. Could you confirm the fibre cable is firmly connected to the ONT and hasn't been bent sharply anywhere?
Customer: It looks connected fine.
Agent: In that case this is likely a fibre-line issue on our side. I'm logging a fault ticket now — reference FT-2026-33012. A technician will visit within 24 hours.
Customer: Is there compensation for the downtime?
Agent: If the outage exceeds our published SLA, a bill credit is applied automatically to your next cycle — no action needed on your part.
Customer: Okay, thank you.

Agent: I've also gone ahead and added a note on your account so if you contact us again about this, the team will have full context.
Customer: Great, appreciate it.
Agent: You're welcome — is there anything else I can help with today?
Customer: No, that's everything.

## Diagnostic Notes (Internal)

- Identity verified via registered number and OTP.
- Relevant backend status checked before providing resolution timeline.
- Case closed after customer confirmation; escalated only if unresolved beyond the stated SLA.

## Escalation

This case was resolved on the first contact.

No directly linked documents are recorded for this item; refer to the relevant department for further guidance.
